Chapter 1037: Chapter 4: The Terrifying Fierce Sun Divine Body (Requesting Monthly Votes)

The numerous Seeds of the Fierce Sun intertwined, forming the embryonic shape of a cycle.

Thus it repeated.

Endlessly.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s physical body was rapidly accelerating in its transformation into the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

The searing heat between heaven and earth surged continuously into him.

“I can feel it—my physical body’s metamorphosis into the Fierce Sun Divine Body has been drastically shortened in time, something that initially would have required three to five thousand years.”

Now?

It would only take three to five years.

“Only three thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun, and already such phenomena?”

Lin Yuan was well aware of the number of Seeds of the Fierce Sun within him—only thirty thousand.

It had not yet reached thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three.

Hence, the cycle formed by the Seeds of the Fierce Sun was merely in its embryonic state.

Even so, Lin Yuan could feel the changes in his physical body and soul, as though immersed in a hot spring.

Exceedingly comfortable, and his comprehension of the rules had further advanced significantly.

No longer at the previous tortoise-like pace.

“These Seeds of the Fierce Sun seem to be forming a broken imprint?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred as he diverted a thread of his consciousness to probe into it.

Boom!

Lin Yuan’s awareness instantly soared to infinite heights, arriving at a place filled with boundless Fierce Sun.

This place was entirely crimson red, as if it were the sole existence in the world.

“What is that?”

Lin Yuan raised his gaze to find a figure silently standing at an immeasurable height.

This figure radiated infinite light and heat, lacking a definitive shape—its form varied a millionfold depending on the perspective of the beholder.

Buzz, buzz, buzz.

In the instant he saw the figure, Lin Yuan’s consciousness began to plummet.

“Hoo!”

On the thirteenth floor of the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan exhaled softly.

At this moment, he realized that even with the thirty thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun not yet fully forming the great cycle, they had given him a glimpse of some absolute secrets.

“That figure—could it be the Ancestor of Fierce Sun? The eternal Fierce Sun above the heavens?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart, reasoning that he accessed the crimson space through the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, and that these seeds were indeed connected to the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

It was natural for Lin Yuan to link the two together.

“How terrifying.”

Lin Yuan marveled inwardly. This was the first time he had directly faced a thirteenth-layer temporal being.

The creator of the “Infinite Void” was also a thirteenth-layer temporal being.

However, what Lin Yuan saw back then was merely a residual imprint left by the creator, lacking any concrete thoughts.

But the figure standing amidst the boundless Fierce Sun—whether it was the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s authentic form or even just an avatar—gave Lin Yuan an overwhelmingly oppressive presence.

“In this lifetime, can I truly achieve such a level?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts expanded. Neither the Moyu Tower Master nor Xuanhuang, nor even the creator of the “Infinite Void,” had left any method or description for crossing into the thirteenth layer.

A twelfth-layer being’s advance to the thirteenth layer, compared to an eleventh-layer being attempting to reach the twelfth, was nowhere near as perilous. It wasn’t simply a matter of success or death.

For a twelfth-layer being to transcend into the thirteenth layer, there was simply no fixed method or path.

“Forget it.”

“First, I’ll cultivate to the Chaos Realm.”

Lin Yuan consolidated his thoughts—the thirteenth-layer matters were still far too distant.

At present, Lin Yuan wasn’t even at the Chaos Realm, nor at the Dominator Realm—he was merely at the Path Splitting Realm.

…

“The ‘Infinite Void’ has been mastered, and the Martial Tao has once again reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm. As of now, my strength, though not on par with the Chaos Void’s true body, likely is only marginally inferior. While I can’t claim the Chaos Realm, I could easily crush anyone in the Dominator Realm.”

Lin Yuan examined himself, making a concrete assessment of his power.

“If the Fierce Sun Divine Body completes its transformation fully, then I might not be weaker than a true body.”

Lin Yuan speculated to himself.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body was the strongest physique of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country—second to none.

Especially within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, it was rumored that when the Fierce Sun Divine Body operated to its extreme, it could wield even a minuscule fraction of the eternal Fierce Sun’s power above the heavens.

Under such circumstances, even if the Chaos Void’s true body successfully comprehended and replicated the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

Its ability to exert its power could never match Lin Yuan’s own.

…

Outside Qingfen City.

Several figures stood motionlessly in midair.

Among them, a violet-haired woman stood as the lead.

“Senior Sister, is it true that the master plans to act against the Qingfen Domain?”

Behind the violet-haired woman was a man who looked ahead toward the majestic Qingfen City in the distance and asked aloud.

“It is an order from the capital—the master cannot disobey.”

The violet-haired woman responded.

No matter how powerful the Great Lord might be, they must heed the orders of the Ancient Country—this was the iron law.

Of course, some carefree Great Lords and Heavenly Venerates avoided accepting the Ancient Country’s ennoblement, thus forfeiting many benefits and privileges.

Such individuals were also free from obligations or constraints.

Still, any Great Lord or Heavenly Venerate with even a hint of ambition would generally align themselves with one of the major Ancient Countries.

There was no alternative—within the Ancient Countries lay the most profound legacies, the most accurate guidance, and the strongest protection.

Without affiliating with any Ancient Country, Great Lords and Heavenly Venerates could not foresee a path forward, thus finding progress exceedingly difficult.

“The capital’s orders?”

The man who had spoken earlier did not inquire further.

If it were merely their master’s intentions, there might still be room for change—but the capital?

“What do we need to do?”

An elderly woman with a hunched back directly queried.

“It’s simple.”

“The master will personally intervene, luring away Lord Qingfen.”

“As for us, we’ll infiltrate Qingfen City beforehand. With the master’s methods in place, as long as we don’t act, even Lord Qingfen won’t detect a thing.”

The violet-haired woman continued, “Once Lord Qingfen is led away, we will strike without restraint, causing as much chaos within Qingfen City as possible. Then we can use the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate the formations of Qingfen City. Once back, we’ll decipher its weaknesses.”
